question: Ram, who is half as efficient as Krish, will take 12 days to complete a task if he works alone. If Ram and Krish work together, how long will they take to complete the task?
solution: Given: Efficiency of Ram = (Efficiency of Krish)/2 Time taken by Ram to complete work = 12 days Concept used: Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken Calculation:
